correctness.rationale: The pure quadratic harmonic space decomposes into four orthogonal and invariant signed-permutation sectors. Polar Gaussian reduction and order statistics give exact sector Rayleigh quotients. The single oriented face halves antipodal-union energies. A truncated chi-square variance bound, strict gamma recurrence and strict exponential covariance prove the full spectral order for every integer d>=4. Standard chi-square-maximal tails give a sharp 2(log d)^2 condition-number asymptotic. Symbolic polynomial identity verification, trace conservation and independent original-cone numerical sampling are reproduced by the attached scripts.

value.rationale: The cell is one of 2d natural Voronoi pieces under the signed coordinate-axis partition, a genuine non-axial observation geometry. Exact four-sector eigenvalues, sharp extrema and sharp logarithmic conditioning give a complete infinite-family stability classification not captured by an isolated three-dimensional computation. Both weakest and strongest observation spaces are explicit. The narrow degree-two and continuous-data scope is clear.
